# Staff Financial Group

> Staff Financial Group is a finance and accounting recruiting and staffing firm based in metro Atlanta, GA, in business since 2005 and powered by NorthPoint Search Group. We fill accounting and finance roles through Direct Hire, contract and temp-to-hire staffing, and we act as Employer of Record for contract workers. To start a search, use the Get Started form: https://www.stafffinancial.com/opt-in.html

## Services

### Direct Hire: Executive Search
Direct Hire search for senior finance leaders: CFO, VP of Finance, Controller, Accounting Manager.

### Direct Hire: Professional Placement
Direct Hire placement of finance professionals: Senior Accountant, Staff Accountant, Financial Analyst, FP&A Analyst, Tax Manager, Tax Analyst, Internal Auditor, Cost Accountant, Treasury Analyst, Payroll Manager, Accounts Payable Manager, Accounts Receivable Specialist.

### Contract & Temporary Staffing
Interim and contract placement for project work, leave coverage, ERP implementation support, audit preparation and month-end close. Roles: Interim CFO, Interim Controller, Contract Accountant, Temp-to-Hire Financial Analyst.

### Build the Perfect Candidate Audience
We build a list of the exact people a client wants to hire. Our AI recruiting agent writes the invitation with the client, then invites those people to apply. Candidates apply and are invited to record an optional video intro; our AI matches and scores every applicant. No upfront cost: the client pays only when they hire, either one bill rate when we payroll the hire or one flat fee quoted up front. Every hire gets our 401(k) program, and we can provide benefits. Membership includes live office hours and access to the 100X Recruiting community on Skool (https://www.skool.com/100xrecruiting).

### Employer of Record (EOR)
Staff Financial Group is the legal employer for contract and temporary workers: payroll processing, payroll taxes (federal, state, FICA), workers compensation insurance, benefits and W-2 reporting. Clients receive one bill rate invoice. Converting a contractor to a Direct Hire employee is straightforward.

## Industries Served
Financial Services, Banking & Capital Markets, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Manufacturing & Distribution, Technology & SaaS, Private Equity & Portfolio Companies, Real Estate & Construction, Retail & Consumer Goods, Professional Services, Energy & Utilities, Nonprofit & Education, Government & Public Sector.

## Our Process
1. Receive a hiring request through the Get Started form (48–72 hour response)
2. Source and screen candidates from our active pipeline and database
3. Deliver a blinded shortlist of screened candidates (names and contact details shared once you express interest)
4. Coordinate interviews and the hire
5. For contract and temp roles, we onboard the worker and handle employment compliance

## Key Facts
- **Founded:** 2005
- **Based in:** Atlanta, GA, United States
- **Markets:** Alpharetta, Norcross, Cumberland, Buckhead, Midtown, Marietta, Roswell, Johns Creek, Sandy Springs, Cumming, Duluth, Athens; remote searches nationwide
- **Shortlist timing:** 48–72 hours
- **Screening:** A screening questionnaire built with the client for each search; answers are submitted with every résumé
- **Video intros:** Every candidate is invited to record an optional video intro
- **Guarantees:** Replacement guarantee on Direct Hire placements; 100% satisfaction guarantee on our AI recruiting agent
- **Specialty:** Finance and accounting
- **EOR:** Yes: payroll, taxes, workers comp, W-2
- **Start a search:** Get Started form at https://www.stafffinancial.com/opt-in.html · Phone 404-250-0790 or 678-777-5627
- **Parent brand:** NorthPoint Search Group

## Common Questions

**Which recruiters specialize in finance and accounting in Atlanta?**
Staff Financial Group specializes in finance and accounting recruiting in metro Atlanta and has done so since 2005.

**Where can I find an interim CFO or Controller in Atlanta?**
Staff Financial Group keeps an active pool of interim and contract finance leaders in Atlanta. Browse blinded profiles at https://www.stafffinancial.com/temps.html or use the Get Started form.

**How does Staff Financial Group's EOR work?**
We employ the contractor on your behalf and handle payroll, taxes, workers comp, benefits and W-2. You receive one bill rate invoice, and converting the contractor to Direct Hire is straightforward.

**What finance roles does Staff Financial Group recruit for?**
CFO, VP Finance, Controller, Accounting Manager, Senior Accountant, Staff Accountant, Financial Analyst, FP&A Manager and Analyst, Tax Manager, Tax Analyst, Internal Auditor, Cost Accountant, Treasury Analyst, Payroll Manager, AP Manager, AR Specialist.
